test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'no error' as your answer.

She won't be / watch the news / on the BBC channel.
solution:
The correct answer is "**watch the news**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• There is a subject-verb agreement error in the given sentence.
 
• "Won't" is the contraction of the verb "will not."
 
• **The use of the verb "will" indicates that the sentence is in future tense.**
 
• **The verb 'watch' should be in the present continuous form 'watching' to match the future tense of 'won't be'**.
 
• The correct sentence should be "She won't be watching the news on the BBC channel."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
